metric.name: Design Class
metric.description: Predicted design category of the protein, such as miniprotein, peptide, or nanobody. Proteins that cannot be classified into a defined category receive label "Other"

metric.name: Molecular Weight
metric.description: Molecular weight of the protein in daltons, computed from its amino-acid composition.

metric.name: Isoelectric Point
metric.description: Theoretical isoelectric point (pI), the pH at which the protein carries no net charge, computed from its sequence.

metric.name: SeqIdentity
metric.description: Percent identity of the query sequence to its closest match in the searched databases, from 0 to 100. Higher values mean the sequence is more similar to a known protein.

metric.name: Novelty
metric.description: Novelty score from 1 to 4 combining sequence and structural similarity to known proteins. Higher values indicate a sequence and fold more distinct from existing databases.

metricSchema.description: Novelty of a sequence against known protein structures/sequences

metric.name: Esmfold Plddt
metric.description: ESMFold per-residue confidence (predicted lDDT), reported from 0 to 100. Higher values indicate a more confidently predicted local structure.

metricSchema.description: ESMFold Predicted Local Distance Difference Test (pLDDT)

metric.name: Foldstring
metric.description: Compact string summarizing the secondary-structure topology, using E for β-strand and H for α-helix. Serves as a fingerprint of the protein's fold.

metric.name: Classification
metric.description: Secondary-structure-based class of the protein, indicating whether it is predominantly alpha, beta, mixed, or has little secondary structure.

metricSchema.description: Protein classification based on secondary structure content

metric.name: Ted Confidence
metric.description: Confidence of the TED domain segmentation (Lau et al., Science 2024) for the assigned domain boundaries. Higher values indicate more reliable domain calls. Consenus between Chainsaw, Merizo and Unidoc

metricSchema.description: TED confidence Lau et al, Science (2024)

metric.name: Domain Match
metric.description: Domain match with database entry including all metrics

metric.name: Esmfold Plddt
metric.description: ESMFold per-residue confidence (predicted lDDT), reported from 0 to 100. Higher values indicate a more confidently predicted local structure.

metricSchema.description: ESMFold Predicted Local Distance Difference Test (pLDDT)

metric.name: Proteinmpnn Score
metric.description: ProteinMPNN design score (negative log-likelihood, default model) of the original sequence given its predicted backbone. Lower scores indicate a sequence ProteinMPNN considers more designable for that fold.

metricSchema.description: ProteinMPNN design score using default model for the original sequence

metric.name: Redesigned Proteinmpnn Score
metric.description: ProteinMPNN design score (negative log-likelihood, default model) for sequences redesigned on the predicted structure of the original sequence. A value close to the original score suggests ProteinMPNN favors the original sequence, and lower is better.

metricSchema.description: ProteinMPNN design score using default model for redesigned sequences given predicted structure of the original sequence

metric.name: Proteinmpnn Seq Recovery
metric.description: Percentage of positions at which ProteinMPNN redesigns recover the original amino acid, from 0 to 100. Higher recovery indicates the original sequence is well matched to its backbone.

metric.name: Pae File
metric.description: Reference to the predicted alignment error (PAE) matrix file, stored as a downloadable artifact for the predicted structure.

metric.name: Boltz2 Plddt
metric.description: Boltz2 per-residue confidence (predicted lDDT) in the predicted structure. Higher values indicate higher confidence.

metric.name: Boltz2 Ptm
metric.description: Boltz2 predicted TM-score for the overall fold, ranging from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate higher confidence in the predicted structure.

metric.name: Boltz2 Iptm
metric.description: Boltz2 predicted interface TM-score for the complex, ranging from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate higher confidence in the predicted interface.

metric.name: Boltz2 Complex Plddt
metric.description: Boltz2 per-residue confidence (predicted lDDT) for the complex. Higher values indicate higher confidence in the predicted complex structure.

metric.name: Boltz2 Complex Iplddt
metric.description: Boltz2 interface per-residue confidence (predicted lDDT) for the complex. Higher values indicate higher confidence in the predicted interface.

metric.name: Boltz2 Complex Pde
metric.description: Boltz2 predicted distance error for the complex, estimating expected error in inter-residue distances. Lower values indicate higher confidence.

metric.name: Boltz2 Ipsae
metric.description: Interface predicted aligned error score (ipSAE), a confidence measure for the binder–target interface that is robust to disordered residues, here taking the maximum over the chain pair. Higher values indicate a more confidently predicted interface.

metric.name: Boltz2 Pdockq
metric.description: Predicted DockQ score estimating complex/interface quality from interface pLDDT (Bryant et al.), ranging from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate a more reliable predicted interface.

metric.name: Boltz2 Pdockq2
metric.description: Predicted DockQ2 score estimating interface quality from per-pair predicted alignment error (Zhu et al.), ranging from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate a more reliable predicted interface.

metric.name: Boltz2 Lis
metric.description: Local Interaction Score derived from a transform of the predicted alignment error at the interface (Kim et al.). Higher values indicate stronger predicted inter-chain interactions.

metric.name: Boltz2 Min Ipsae
metric.description: Interface predicted aligned error score (ipSAE) for the binder–target interface, taking the minimum over the chain pair as proposed by Overath et al. Higher values indicate a more confidently predicted interface.

metricSchema.description: minimum Interface Predicted Alignment Error (ipsae) score

metric.name: Interface Residues
metric.description: List of residues forming the interface, each given as a chain and residue number. A residue is counted as interface if any of its atoms lie within 4.5 Å of the other chain.

metricSchema.description: List of interface residues with chain and residue number

metric.name: Shape Complimentarity Boltz2 Binder Ss
metric.description: Shape complementarity of the binder–target interface for the Boltz2-predicted complex (binder predicted without an MSA). Higher values indicate better-fitting interface geometry.

metricSchema.description: Shape complementarity score for for complex predicted by Boltz2 (no MSA for binder).
